review_notes: Chapter reconciliation: mul penei is now one fused unit (rule 30), matching the same correction at NUM.8.2. Only the word front is spent on the pair, the in being el's and the of the rectum's.
The added italic so as to give light is unchanged: no morpheme in this verse licenses it, and neither el nor the fused mul penei is a home for it, since each already holds the English written for it.
Head on mul rather than penei is the choice made; heading on penei remains defensible.
